@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'FoundationModels: report each MLXLanguageModel call''s MTP outcome in Transcript.Response metadata'
+---
+Requested by the Router session (foundationmodelsrouter-ce): Router turns MTP on (Qwen3.8-27B-4bit + Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-4bit) for SWE-bench and its telemetry must prove MTP ran. On stable 148f227e the MTP outcome (GenerateCompletionInfo.speculativeDecodingFallbackReason, accepted/drafted tokens) is only visible through the internal test-only `generationObserver`. Router already reads `Transcript.Response.metadata["incompleteOutput"]` emitted through `emitMetadata`; use the same channel.
+
+On each response entry of a call made with `speculativeDecoding != nil`, emit metadata:
+- [ ] `"speculativeDecoding"`: Bool — true when MTP drafted in at least one round of the call's passes.
+- [ ] `"speculativeDecodingFallbackReason"`: String — the `SpeculativeDecodingFallbackReason` case name when a pass fell back to plain decode; key absent when there was no fallback.
+- [ ] `"acceptedDraftTokenCount"`: Int and `"draftedTokenCount"`: Int — summed over all passes of the call (think-then-call phases, tool turns, guided generation).
+- [ ] A call with `speculativeDecoding == nil` emits none of these keys.
+- [ ] Covers text, reasoning, allowed/required tools, guided generation, streaming and non-streaming paths.
+- [ ] Tests in a new file: each key present/absent as above, sums across passes, fallback case (incompatible drafter), no-MTP call emits none.
+- [ ] Document the keys in Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/README.md (MTP section).
+
+#mtp #foundation-models
\ No newline at end of file

+    Picked up on a worktree reset to mtp 268dab08. Research:
+    - Every non-guided pass of MLXLanguageModel (text, reasoning, allowed tools, think-then-call phase 1) ends in `Executor.observeCompletion(info)`; GenerateCompletionInfo carries `speculativeDecodingTelemetry` (draftTokenCount / acceptedDraftTokenCount, nil when roundCount == 0) and `speculativeDecodingFallbackReason` (.incompatibleDrafter on the FM paths).
+    - Guided passes (schema, required-tool phase 2) run `GuidedGenerationLoop.run`, which returns only a token count; its MTP rounds reach only `GuidedGenerationDiagnosticSink` (recordSpeculativeRound, recordSpeculationFallback with a stated reason string, no case). The sink is task-local and test-bound; binding a full sink in production would record a mask + bias copy per decision and run a top-two sort + `.item` sync per token (GuidedDecoder.recordDecisionMargin), so production needs a speculation-only sink mode. Tests (GuidedGenerationMTPTestSupport) bind an outer sink across an executor call, so the executor must read deltas from an outer sink rather than shadow it.
+    - `Transcript.Response.metadata` is public ([String: GeneratedContent]) on the 27 SDK, so tests can assert the real transcript entry of a session turn.
+    Plan: one per-call `SpeculativeDecodingOutcome` (task-local, bound in respond when speculativeDecoding != nil) fed by observeCompletion and by a guided-pass wrapper reading sink deltas; emitted once on the response entry at the end of runRespond. Fallback reason = the first fallback a pass of the call reported.

+- [ ] `IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/TextGeneration/MTPGenerationTests.swift:121` `completeness/invariant-propagation` — The real-model test checks the reported `acceptedDraftTokenCount` against zero but never checks `draftedTokenCount` against the completion's own count, nor the fallback reason. The same invariant the metadata reports (the drafts the call proposed) is therefore unproven on the real model. A regression that reports the wrong draft total, for example summing only one of the passes, would pass this test. Add `#expect(try mtp.metadata["draftedTokenCount"]?.value(Int.self) == mtp.completion.proposedDraftTokens)` and the matching assertion for `acceptedDraftTokenCount` against `mtp.completion.acceptedDraftTokens`, so the metadata is tied to the completion source on the real model.
+- [ ] `Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/MLXLanguageModel.swift:1296` `completeness/public-output-contract` — The MTP outcome is emitted only on the success path, after the `do` block completes. When a pass throws, the `CancellationError` and generic `catch` branches set `outcome` without calling `emitSpeculativeDecodingOutcome`. A call of a model with a drafter that drafted and then failed or was cancelled therefore writes no `speculativeDecoding`, `draftedTokenCount` or `acceptedDraftTokenCount` into its response entry, even though the drafts were proposed and partly accepted. The intended side-effect (reporting the MTP outcome of the call) is silently dropped on the error path. Emit the outcome on every exit of the pass that the response entry is written for, for example in a `defer`-like step after the `do/catch`, or call `emitSpeculativeDecodingOutcome` in the failure branches too. Add one test where a speculating call is cancelled or throws mid-generation and assert what the response entry reports, or document that failed calls report nothing.
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/SpeculativeDecodingOutcomeMetadataTests.swift:150` `reuse/reuse` — The helper re-implements the "last response entry of the session transcript" extraction inline. The same compactMap-then-last pattern is written again in the integration test's `MTPGenerationTests.swift` (lines 89-92), so the transcript-reading logic has two copies that can drift apart. Extract it once beside `MTPTurnLog` in `MTPExecutorTestSupport.swift` and call it from both places. Add a shared helper, for example `func lastResponse(of transcript: Transcript) -> Transcript.Response?`, in `MTPExecutorTestSupport.swift`, and call it from `respond` here. The integration target cannot import that test support file, so either accept the copy there or move the helper into a module both targets can import.
